lines: THE WORD MARVEL ISN'T ALLOWED TO PUT ON A COVER

segments.text: There's a deep-sea animal that builds an entire house out of its own snot. Then it just walks away.
But the house — pure mucus, up to three feet wide — is bigger than the room you're sitting in.
And it clogs — every single day — so the animal abandons the whole house and builds a brand new one from scratch.
Multiply that by every larvacean in the ocean, and you've got one of the planet's biggest carbon pumps — built entirely out of snot nobody wanted.
